summary.text: Mark Costello is a Republican who represents District 8 in the Iowa Senate, according to the Iowa Legislature's member page.

That page lists Mark Costello's General Assembly service beginning with the term that started in 2013, and its current standing committee assignments include Agriculture, Appropriations, Health and Human Services (Vice Chair), Natural Resources and Environment, Transportation, and Veterans Affairs.
The page identifies Mark Costello as vice chair of Health and Human Services.
